snippet.title: StopotS - The Categories Game
snippet.description:
Stopots is the classic Categories game brought to the online world. Play in real time with friends or players from anywhere around the globe.

When the round starts, a random letter is chosen, and your goal is to fill in all categories before time runs out. The faster and more creative your answers, the higher your score.

Features:
• Play with friends: Create private rooms or join public rooms
• Multiple languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, and more
• Custom avatars and themes: Personalize your experience
• Rankings: Show who’s the fastest thinker

Low on storage? Play the web app at https://stopots.com/
